title: Prospective and Retrospective Integrated Monitoring Clinical Register in Head and Neck Cancer
summary:
The PRIMe-HNC registry systematically collects clinical data from patients with malignant tumors of the head and neck region. The aim is to better understand treatment courses, therapy outcomes, and potential side effects under real-world clinical conditions. For this purpose, both patients who have already been treated in the past (retrospective data collection) and newly treated patients (prospective data collection) will be included in the registry.

The registry collects information on the tumor disease, the treatments performed (e.g., surgery, radiotherapy, or systemic therapy), possible side effects, as well as the further course of the disease and patients’ quality of life. Patient treatment follows current medical guidelines and is not influenced or modified by participation in the registry.

The collected data will help to improve future treatment decision-making, enable earlier recognition of therapy-related side effects, and contribute to the long-term improvement of care for patients with head and neck cancer.
conditions: Histologically confirmed malignant tumor in the head and neck region: - Tumors of the aerodigestive tract (oral cavity/floor, upper/lower jaw, nasopharynx/oropharynx/hypopharynx, larynx, sinuses, nose) - Lateral tumors: salivary gland tumors - Tumors of the skin in the head and neck region

interventions.name:
1. Retrospective cohort
Patients with histologically confirmed malignant tumors of the head and neck region who were treated between 2016 and 2025 at the University Hospital Giessen. Clinical, diagnostic, therapeutic, and outcome data will be collected retrospectively from routine clinical records

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Histologically confirmed malignant tumor in the head and neck region:
- Tumors of the aerodigestive tract (oral cavity/floor, upper/lower jaw, nasopharynx/oropharynx/hypopharynx, larynx, sinuses, nose)
- Lateral tumors: salivary gland tumors
- Tumors of the skin in the head and neck region
• Age ≥ 18 years
• For prospective phase: written consent
Exclusion criteria:
• Benign tumors
• Incomplete basic data (retrospective)
